recordingRules.title: Recording rules

errors.stale-reference: Recording configuration changed. Refresh this read-only view.
errors.foreign-scope: Recording evidence is not available in the selected workspace and device.

recordingRules.scopeUnavailable: Recording evidence unavailable until the selected workspace and device revisions are known.
recordingRules.notIntake: Verified configuration is not proof of current intake or SQL delivery.
recordingRules.requestedNote: A separate requested-revision snapshot is not supplied; a requested revision does not prove current execution.
recordingRules.savedNote: Saved settings do not prove the configuration currently executing.

recordingDelivery.title: Delivery evidence
recordingDelivery.shared: Shared group totals across devices; not device or Tag success counts.
recordingDelivery.groupTotals: Group totals; not device or Tag success counts.
recordingDelivery.unitsNote: Accepted samples and output rows use different units and are not added.
recordingDelivery.backlogNote: Each entry retains its original destination and revision; it is not relabeled from saved settings.
recordingDelivery.noBacklog: No retained backlog reported in this observation.
recordingDelivery.replayNote: Replay samples may also appear in collecting; do not add them to finalized output rows.
recordingDelivery.noReplay: No accepted-input replay quarantine reported in this observation.
recordingDelivery.preserveInputs: Preserve accepted inputs and restore the original immutable revision evidence, or contact maintenance.

reasons.recording-cutover-finalized-overlap: Finalized recording windows overlap at cutover

guidance.none: No action is implied by this evidence.
guidance.refresh: Use the recording evidence refresh to read again; settings are not changed.
guidance.inspect-settings: Review the referenced settings without modifying retained data.
guidance.open-workspace-list: Review the selected workspace scope without substituting another entity.
guidance.inspect-immutable-evidence: Inspect the original immutable evidence; do not change or resend retained data.

recordingDetails.title: Source and receipt details
recordingDetails.groupWide: This receipt belongs to the whole group; it does not establish every source or Tag result.
recordingDetails.sourceNote: Latest local observations and last committed windows are independent; a local result alone does not establish SQL commitment.
recordingDetails.noSources: No source result reported for this device in this observation.
recordingDetails.independentPhases: Test-write, runtime commitment, independent readback and owned cleanup require separate evidence. No phase implies another.

recordingTiming.title: Observed timing
recordingTiming.observedNote: Observed values from the last read; not a live clock or countdown.
recordingTiming.scopeNote: Oldest pending age covers all revisions of this group, not only this device or the current revision.

settingsLink.revisionHint: Revision hints are informational; settings are revalidated against the current revision.
settingsLink.sharedGroup: Shared group settings include other devices; this link does not narrow group-wide totals.

locatorEntry.unavailable: The requested settings are unavailable. Refresh and try again.
locatorEntry.stale: This selection has changed. Choose a current item from the proven workspace list.
locatorEntry.foreign: This workspace or selection is inaccessible. No other workspace has been selected.
locatorEntry.invalid: This settings link is invalid. No settings have been selected.
locatorEntry.removed: This item was removed. A same-name replacement has not been selected.
locatorEntry.draftBlocked: Your existing edits are kept. Resolve them before opening a different settings selection.
locatorEntry.unrequested: Only the requested entity is loaded; other settings have not been read.
locatorEntry.historicalHint: Requested revision {{revision}} is informational only; it does not authorize edits or replace current revision checks.
locatorEntry.destinationUnknown: The current destination has not been read; this is not evidence of a different destination.
locatorEntry.selectionConflict: The requested selection conflicts with the current editing context.

recordingResources.title: Quota and storage evidence
recordingResources.quotaNote: Quota bytes are not selected-device or Tag totals and do not prove SQL delivery or intake permission.
recordingResources.quotaUnavailable: Quota evidence unavailable or not configured.
recordingResources.storageScope: Bound to the verified frozen destination and revision.
recordingResources.historyLoss: Earlier destination history may be lost
recordingResources.noEvents: No storage events in this verified observation.
recordingResources.storageUnavailable: Frozen-destination storage history and events unavailable.
recordingResources.notPermission: Storage evidence does not grant repair permission or prove restored history.
